summary: Jack Henry & Associates filed an 8-K reporting that its Board approved adding 5 million shares to its existing stock repurchase authorization, increasing the total authorization to 6.4 million shares (from 1.4 million remaining). The company has repurchased just over 2 million shares in fiscal year 2026. The buyback program, initiated in October 2002 and increased eight times, will be funded with available cash or short-term borrowings. No price targets or timetables are set. The move signals management's confidence in operations and commitment to shareholder returns. Watch for execution pace and impact on EPS.
